title: Location Optimization Strategy - DTTL - DM - Hyderabad
description:
**Deputy Manager, Location Strategy Optimization (USI)**

 **Role Purpose**

  

Are you a detail\-oriented project manager with a passion for operational excellence and cross\-functional collaboration? As Deputy Manager, Location Strategy Optimization, you will play a pivotal role in driving the tactical execution of our location strategy—helping move location decisions away from ad‑hoc, reactive choices toward a systematic, data\-driven, enterprise\-wide approach that balances talent, cost, risk, and long‑term sustainability. You will help create consistency, transparency, and maturity in how locations are evaluated, launched, stabilized, and continuously optimized as strategic assets.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Project \& Program Coordination:** Manage day\-to\-day workplans, timelines, risks, and interdependencies; maintain action trackers, decision logs, and status reports to ensure disciplined execution. Coordinate activities across the end\-to\-end location strategy “Stages of Maturity” for both new locations and strategic re\-assessments of existing hubs.

**Executive Communications:** Prepare polished presentation materials and briefing packs for councils and leadership forums, ensuring content is executive\-ready and impactful. Provide concise leadership updates on strategy progress, shifts in assumptions, and key risks/constraints.

**Governance Support:** Provide operational support to location\-focused councils and governance forums (e.g., Location Optimization Council, Global Delivery Center Governance Forum), including agenda preparation, note taking, action/decision tracking, and follow\-ups. Support intake/triage of topics so governance focuses on systemic, cross\-location issues (vs. one\-off issues owned by the relevant COE/domain leader).

**Risk \& Opportunity Management:** Maintain and update the Risk, Issues, and Opportunities (RIO) log and cross\-geo watchlists; triage and escalate systemic items for review and resolution through governance forums. Monitor both performance risks and external/contextual risks that could affect long\-term viability.

**Data \& Insights:** Gather and synthesize fresh inputs to stress\-test location guidance and related analyses, supporting data\-driven hub recommendations balancing risk, talent, and cost. Support annual maintenance/validation of identified strategic locations using the Location Guidance model and ongoing analysis of business decisions for alignment with the Location Strategy. Help apply the “control vs influence vs cannot control” framing to make realistic accountability and constraints clear to stakeholders.

**Standards \& Operating Frameworks:** Support defining and maintaining global standards for how locations operate, including location tiering frameworks and cost\-by\-level, global playbooks, SLAs, and operating standards (including security/compliance/governance expectations). Help drive adoption of standards across geographies while respecting local realities.

**Operational Integration \& Relationship Management:** Support operational integration across strategic Deloitte firms, Shared Services, Delivery Centers, and alternate delivery model (ADM) channels, identifying gaps and maintaining documented ways of working. Support Shared Services leaders to refine Delivery Center and ADM strategies and uncover opportunities to support broader Global business areas.

**Risk Mitigation \& Guardrails:** Ensure processes align with legal frameworks and agreed guardrails; support risk mitigation activities leveraging expertise from Office of the General Counsel (OGC), Tax, and other contributors. Help educate stakeholders on legal boundaries and operational constraints.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work effectively in a matrixed environment, partnering with COE Leads and designated Points of Contact to integrate cross\-functional inputs and ensure alignment. Work closely with Finance, Shared Services, and other functional teams to ensure alignment across financial structures and operational processes (e.g., billing, time tracking, expense management, financial systems, funding models).

**Process \& Documentation:** Keep SOPs, playbooks, and governance artifacts current and accessible; maintain clear process documentation that outlines steps for evaluating, selecting, and managing strategic locations.

**Enablement \& Change:** Develop and maintain toolkits, playbooks, and guidance; support change management and communications to enable adoption and best practice sharing. Develop targeted training modules, FAQs, and job aids; track participation/completion and refine materials based on stakeholder feedback.

**Scenario Planning \& Contingency Management:** Support contingency protocols and escalation procedures for geopolitical, regulatory, or market changes impacting location and delivery center strategies; facilitate scenario planning workshops/tabletop exercises and document lessons learned.

**Performance Metrics:** Support establishing and tracking KPIs to measure effectiveness of the Location Strategy, Delivery Center/ADM collaboration, and operational integration; conduct post\-implementation reviews, capture lessons learned, and recommend process improvements.

**AI\-Enabled Delivery:** Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, analysis, and visualization; adapt quickly to shifting priorities and new technologies.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 6\-8 years’ experience in project management, PMO, or operations roles within global, matrixed environments, with a proven track record of execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, HR, Economics, Data/Analytics, or a related field.
* Strong project management skills: schedule and dependency management, RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), change control, and meeting facilitation.
* Advanced communication and design abilities: expert in PowerPoint storytelling, creating clean visuals, and writing succinct executive summaries.
* Analytical fluency: confident with Excel (pivot tables, lookups), basic data modeling, dashboard interpretation, and turning data into actionable recommendations.
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools (e.g., Copilot/GenAI) for drafting, summarization, slide creation, and data interrogation.
* Experience collaborating in a matrix structure, coordinating work across dotted\-line contributors, and ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities.
* Preferred/Bonus: PMP®/PRINCE2® Foundation, Lean Six Sigma Yellow/Green Belt; exposure to delivery centers/ADM and global standards/playbooks; familiarity with Power BI/Tableau and SharePoint/OneNote.
* Flexibility to work across time zones as needed.

**Why Join Us?**


You’ll join a high\-impact team at the heart of our global location strategy, working closely with senior leaders and stakeholders. We offer a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions will drive meaningful changes improving how locations are governed, standardized, and continuously optimized over time.


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
**Recruiting tips**  


From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Change Manger
description:
**Position Overview**


**Job Title****:** Change Manager
  

**Department** : People, Strategy \& Transformation
  

**Location** : Bengaluru
  

**Reports To** : Manager – Strategy \& Communications
  

**Experience** : 3–5 years in change management, transformation, or OD


**About NNE IN**


NNE is a leading pharma engineering consultancy headquartered in Denmark, with a strong and growing presence in India. We specialise in designing and building advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities for the world's leading life science companies. NNE IN combines deep technical expertise with people\-centric delivery to bring complex projects to life with quality, compliance, and speed.


Beyond client engagements, NNE IN is also actively transforming itself as an organisation — through strategic, cultural, digital, and capability\-building initiatives that strengthen how we work, lead, and grow together. Our change practitioners play a critical role in shaping both: how we deliver change for clients and how we evolve as an organisation.  

  



**Role Purpose**


The Change Manager (Mid\-Level) is responsible for planning and executing structured change management activities across NNE IN – drive wide transformation initiatives — including strategic, organisational, cultural, digital, process, and capability\-building changes where required. This role focuses on the practical delivery of change at scale, enabling people, teams, and functions to adopt new ways of working with confidence and consistency


In this role, you will be responsible for leading the change process itself, as change does not happen on its own—it must be continuously driven, facilitated, communicated and followed up on.


Management owns the changes, and you will work closely with directors and people managers to design and implement them.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**1\- Change Strategy \& Planning**


* Develop and execute structured change management plans for organisation\-wide initiatives — operating model changes, digital transformation, cultural shifts, restructuring, and policy rollouts.
* Conduct enterprise\-level change impact assessments and stakeholder analyses across functions \& levels.
* Design and apply change governance frameworks, RACI models, and structures for transformation programmes.
* Integrate change activities into broader organisational transformation roadmaps and strategic planning cycles.

**2\- Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership Alignment**


* Engage stakeholders across all levels — leadership, line managers, and employees — to build trust, alignment, and commitment.
* Facilitate alignment workshops
* Identify, anticipate, and proactively manage resistance across organization through structured interventions.
* Craft compelling change narratives that connect strategy, purpose, and employee experience.
* Tailor messages to diverse audiences — Sr /Jr. Engineers, Line Mgmt., \& Leaders

**3\- Readiness, Adoption \& Behavioral Change**


* Execute readiness assessments
* Design and execute mechanisms to embed change sustainably
* Translate insights into actionable recommendations for leadership.

**4 Change Capability \& Continuous Improvement**


* Contribute to building NNE IN's internal Change Management
* Mentor and uplift change adoption mindset across organization.

**Qualifications \& Experience**


**1\-Essential**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, HR, Organisational Psychology, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in agile change management, organizational development, \& transformation,.
* Demonstrated experience supporting organisation\-wide change initiatives (digital, cultural, operating model, process, or capability) — not limited to single projects.
* Working knowledge of structured change frameworks (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter, Bridges, or equivalent).
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills across hierarchies.
* Excellent written and verbal English; ability to craft narratives for both leaders and frontline audiences.

**2\-Preferred**


* Prosci / APMG / CCMP change management certification.
* Experience in pharma, life sciences, engineering consulting, or regulated industries.
* Exposure to cultural transformation, operating model design, M\&A integration, or employee experience programmes.
* Familiarity with digital adoption platforms , survey tools (Glint, Peakon), and collaboration suites (M365, Viva).
* Experience designing and facilitating large\-scale workshops, leadership offsites, or culture interventions.

**Core Competencies**


**1\-Enterprise Stakeholder Engagement**


Builds trusted relationships across functions and levels; mobilises sponsors, champions, and influencers across the organisation


**2\-Strategic Change Execution**


Translates strategic intent into pragmatic, scalable change plans that deliver adoption and measurable outcomes.


**3\-Analytical \& Systems Thinking**


Connects dots across people, process, technology, and culture; uses data and frameworks to diagnose and design interventions.


**4\-Communication \& Storytelling**


Crafts clear, compelling, and audience\-tailored narratives that inspire commitment and clarity through change.


**5\-Learning Agility**


Adapts quickly to new contexts, technologies, and organisational shifts; brings curiosity and a continuous\-improvement mindset


**6\-Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


Partners seamlessly with cross disciplines to integrated change outcomes


**7\-Behavioural Insight**


Understands human responses to change; designs interventions that drive sustained behavioural and cultural shifts.


**8\-Growth Mindset**


Embraces ambiguity, learns from setbacks, and elevates the change capability of those around them.
  

  

**Working Conditions \& Travel**


* All 5 days work from office
* Cross\-time zone collaboration with NNE team in Denmark.

**What NNE IN Offers**


* Exposure to organisation\-wide transformation alongside landmark pharma engineering projects.
* Structured career progression with learning opportunities.
* Competitive compensation, performance bonus, comprehensive health \& wellbeing benefits.
* Inclusive, psychologically safe workplace that celebrates diverse perspectives.

Sounds like something you’d love to do? If you’re ready to unleash your potential, let’s have a talk.


Deadline of application is 31st Aug 2026


Questions before applying? Please contact PVYN@nne.com


Please note we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.


To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, we encourage you to refrain from adding a photo in your CV. At NNE, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.


We will invite to interviews on a running basis.
  

  

To learn more about us visit www.nne.com

title: Associate Vice President
description:
**Back Office**
---------------


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
=============================


* Role Purpose
  

The AVP / Senior Director – Back Office Collections owns the complete back\-office engine of
  

the debt collection agency across three specialized functions — the Letter Team, the Placement
  

Team and the Correspondence Team. The role exists to ensure that every consumer
  

communication, account placement and inbound correspondence is processed accurately, on
  

time, and in full compliance with US debt\-collection law (FDCPA, the CFPB’s Regulation F,
  

FCRA, TCPA and applicable state statutes).
  

This is a compliance\-critical leadership role. A single non\-compliant letter or mishandled dispute
  

can create regulatory and reputational risk for the client; the incumbent is the accountable
  

owner who guarantees that does not happen at scale.


* Principal Accountabilities
  

Letter Team


* Own the full lifecycle of consumer collection communications — initial validation notices,
  

follow\-up letters, dispute acknowledgments, settlement offers and statutory notices.
* Guarantee every communication is compliant with FDCPA §1692g validation
  

requirements, Regulation F model validation notice, Mini\-Miranda and state\-specific
  

language mandates.
* Govern pre\-mail scrubs: bankruptcy, deceased, cease\-communication, attorney
  

represented, DNC and litigation suppression before every mail / email / SMS run.
* Manage letter vendors, print\-and\-mail operations and electronic communication
  

(email/SMS) platforms within Reg F frequency and time\-place\-manner limits.
  

Placement Team
* Own the placement, forward\-flow and recall workflows for accounts moving to/from
  

secondary and tertiary collection agencies and legal\-network attorneys.
* Ensure accounts are scrubbed, scored, segmented and validated before any placement
  

or transfer.
* Maintain agency SLAs, liquidation curves, commission reconciliation and compliance
  

scorecards for all downstream partners.
* Manage client recall requests, forward\-placement decisions and post\-placement
  

reconciliation.
  

Correspondence Team
* Lead handling of all inbound written correspondence — consumer disputes, debt
  

validation requests, cease\-and\-desist letters, attorney representation letters, identity\-theft
  

/ FCRA disputes and insurance correspondence.
* Guarantee every item is logged, triaged and resolved within statutory timelines (validation
  

/ dispute handling under FDCPA and Reg F).
* Operate a correspondence SLA tracker and escalation matrix for high\-risk items —
  

litigation threats, CFPB complaints, BBB / AG complaints and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with compliance and legal to respond accurately to regulator and attorney
  

correspondence.
  

Leadership \& Governance
* Lead Managers, Assistant Managers, Team Leads and Specialists across all three
  

functions.
* Present back\-office SLA, compliance and productivity dashboards in client governance
  

reviews.
* Drive process re\-engineering to cut turnaround time, error rates and compliance
  

exceptions.

title: Executive Admin & Event Specialist
description:
#### **Role Overview**



The Executive Assistant at GHX India serves as a cornerstone of executive effectiveness and organizational culture. This role partners directly with senior leadership to keep priorities moving, while also owning the planning and execution of team events and culture programs that make GHX India a great place to work. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, discreet, and genuinely energized by bringing people together.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **Executive Support for Managing Director of India**


* Manage the calendar of the Managing Director of India, including scheduling meetings.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, meals, and ground transportation; provide real\-time support for itinerary adjustments due to schedule changes or disruptions.
* Plan and coordinate executive team events, including venue selection, catering, and onsite support; attend events as needed to stay connected with executive and team needs.
* Prepare, edit, and review documents, presentations, and correspondence with accuracy, clarity, and professionalism.
* Build comprehensive itineraries for conferences and complex travel schedules.
* Track and reconcile executive expenses, manage petty cash purchases, and process expense reports.
* Proactively assess administrative needs, prioritize tasks, and recommend effective solutions to support executive and team operations.
* Organize and maintain electronic and physical files per GHX Security and Compliance guidelines.
* Follow all GHX policies including T\&E, Compliance, and Security policies.
* Assist with special projects and perform additional administrative duties as assigned.

#### **Culture \& Events**


* Plan and execute employee culture and events from concept to close — offsites, celebrations, recognition moments, and milestone gatherings.
* Partner with leadership and HR to bring the company's values to life through meaningful, well\-run experiences.
* Collaborate with the Branding and Marketing team to plan, review, and update employee engagement and corporate social media content.
* Manage HR administrative activities, including maintaining stock and distribution of new hire welcome kits and onboarding materials.
* Own logistics end\-to\-end: venue, vendors, budget, communications, day\-of coordination, and follow\-up.
* Spot opportunities to build connection and morale and bring ideas forward without waiting to be asked.
* Maintain a calendar of recurring culture moments.
* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships with an eye toward quality and cost.

#### **What We're Looking For**


* 3\+ years of experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager, or similar role supporting senior leaders.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with calm and clarity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience coordinating events or programs across a team or organization.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
* A self\-starter who notices what needs to be done and acts without being asked.
* Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Office 365, Teams, AI and calendar management platforms.
* Experience working in a global, cross\-functional organization is a plus.
* Ability to work in the Hyderabad office no less than 3 days per week.

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**  

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.



GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.



It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce \- not shift \- the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.


"

 **Job Description** **Key Responsibilities:** Enhance Employee Global Mobility Experience –

* Provide ongoing, end‑to‑end support to relocating employees on assignment‑related matters including **payroll, benefits, immigration, expenses, insurance, and local benefits** (housing, transportation, schooling, shipping, and local registrations).
* Partner with **Business HR and Talent teams** to assess mobility requests and provide recommendations on **assignment type, duration, cost, and compliance viability** aligned to business needs.
* Draft, refine, interpret, and govern the **Global Mobility SOPs**, including **managing mobility exceptions** in collaboration with **Rewards**, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant application.
* Collaborate closely with **business HR teams** to understand employee mobility needs and support strategic talent movement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with **local immigration laws, tax regulations, employment policies**, and internal governance standards across various jurisdictions.
* **Identify, flag, and proactively mitigate immigration, tax, payroll, and compliance risks** associated with global assignments.
* Ensure all **mobility processes, documentation, and records are audit‑ready** and aligned with internal and external compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with **external partners**, including immigration counsel, relocation service providers, insurance vendors, and Employer of Record (EoR) partners, as required.
* Manage and support **different mobility programs**, including **short‑term assignments, long‑term assignments, international transfers,** and future EoR models.
* Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date **employee mobility records**, tracking assignment durations, work permits, visa expiry dates, and compliance milestones.
* **Track visas and manage visa preparation processes** in coordination with immigration counsel; draft **invitation letters and travel‑related visa documentation**.
* Create and maintain **mobility dashboards, trackers, and reports** (e.g., active assignments, visa expiry risks, cost trends) to support leadership decision‑making and share periodic status updates with the **Rewards CoE**
* **Track and monitor mobility‑related costs** (immigration, relocation, allowances, vendor fees) and provide insights to stakeholders to support **cost‑effective mobility decisions**.
* Prepare and manage **assignment documentation**, including letters of assignment, welcome emails, employee mobility journey maps, employee checklists, and balance sheets. Maintain all expatriate documents and ensure timely upload to the **Personnel file**
* Connect with employees **post‑offer acceptance**, ensuring continuous engagement and support throughout the immigration and relocation lifecycle—including travel bookings, FOREX, home‑country exit formalities, transit support, temporary accommodation, insurance enrolment, and host‑country resources.
* Track the employee journey from **offer acceptance through relocation and the first 30 days of arrival** in the host country.
* Seek required approvals and process **LTA, Children Education Allowance**, and other mobility‑related payments.
* Coordinate with **host‑country HR teams and buddies** to enable smooth onboarding and settlement.
* Calculate **gratuity for exiting expatriates** and support the Finance team with **annuity calculations**.
* Manage **expatriate insurance enrolments and deletions**, including periodic connects with global insurance vendors and census validation.
* Partner closely with **Total Rewards, Talent, SAP DM, Payroll, Finance, Admin, and Travel Desk** teams to support end‑to‑end Global Mobility operations.
* Partner with **HRBPs and Talent teams to support structured repatriation**, focusing on role continuity, compliance, and a positive employee experience.
* Provide recommendations for **continuous improvement of mobility programs and processes** to enhance efficiency, governance, and employee experience.
* Strive to create a **positive, compliant, and employee‑centric experience** for both expatriating and repatriating employees.

  

**Qualifications** **Skills \& Qualification**: Strong knowledge of Excel and HR programs/systems

* You have 5\+ years of experience in global mobility, immigration, or related fields
* You have knowledge of international immigration laws, tax regulations, and employment policies
* You have familiarity with various types of work permits, visas, and relocation processes
* You have exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with employees, managers, and external partners across geographic locations
* You are flexible and considerate of time zones
* You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured environment
* You are a team player who acts with a sense of urgency and adapts to a fast\-paced and ever\-changing environment
* You have strong ethics, demonstrated discretion, and sound judgment while working with sensitive and confidential information.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Maintain a high level of ownership and accountability

  

**Additional Information**  

Benefits Offered


At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.


The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.


" Our Work Culture


Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, integration, automation, and user experience.
  
About you
  
3\+ years' experience administering and supporting SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting and Onboarding within a global organisation.

SuccessFactors Recruiting Management (RXM) certification.

Knowledge of SmartRecruiters.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources Information Systems, Business Systems, or a related field.

This role is work at home based in India. title: HR Administration Analyst
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Could you be the full\-time HR Administration Analyst in Bangalore we’re looking for?

Take on a new challenge and apply your HR operations expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and detail\-oriented teammates.



You'll ensure smooth and timely execution of HR operations activities, with a strong focus on statutory compliance, employee benefit administration, and trust management. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as Business HR, HR Admin, and internal functions), manage external vendor relationships, and proactively address employee and stakeholder concerns to enhance satisfaction.



You’ll specifically take care of managing employee benefit schemes like Gratuity, Provident Fund (PF), National Pension System (NPS), and Superannuation, but also focus on compliance activities and process improvements.



We’ll look to you for:


* End\-to\-end management of Gratuity, Superannuation, and Trust\-related activities
* Timely and accurate processing of employee benefits like NPS, insurance, and service awards
* Proactive stakeholder management to ensure satisfaction and avoid escalations
* Issuance of PR/PO, invoice clearance, and vendor payment tracking
* Driving learning and improvement initiatives to enhance HR operations delivery
* Ensuring effective employee lifecycle support, process governance, and data management
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field
* Hands\-on experience in Gratuity administration and Trust management
* Proficiency in handling Superannuation, NPS, and payroll coordination
* Knowledge of HRIS tools and statutory compliance activities
* Strong stakeholder management and escalation handling capabilities
* Proficiency in HRMS, Excel, and MIS reporting
* Attention to detail, problem\-solving mindset, and excellent communication skills
* Ability to work under timelines and compliance pressure
* High level of integrity and confidentiality
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards leadership roles in HR operations or compliance management
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  



You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Assistant Manager-People Operations
description:
Rentomojo is a leading rental solutions provider redefining the way people access and experience lifestyle products. We believe in delivering quality, flexibility, and innovation while ensuring operational excellence in every area – including compliance. As part of our growing People Operations team, we are looking for a Compliance – Assistant Manager to strengthen our statutory and HR compliance function in partnership with our external compliance vendor.
   

  

 The Assistant Manager – People Operations will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end HR operations, including payroll, employee lifecycle management, HR systems administration, compliance, audits, HR analytics, and employee experience. The ideal candidate will have strong operational expertise, hands\-on experience with PeopleStrong HRMS, and the ability to derive actionable insights from HR data to support business decisions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle
* Manage the complete employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmation, transfers, increments, separations, and full \& final settlements.
* Ensure timely and accurate Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements for exiting employees.
* Coordinate employee documentation, HR letters, and joining formalities.
* Execute exit processes including exit interviews, clearance, and documentation.
* Payroll Management
* Coordinate end\-to\-end monthly payroll inputs, validations, and processing.
* Prepare and validate salary inputs, including new joiners, exits, revisions, and variable payouts.
* Manage salary structures, CTC breakup, reimbursements, and benefits.
* Perform monthly payroll reconciliations across all salary components to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Prepare monthly payroll variance reports and other MIS reports for strategic decision\-making.
* Validate statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, LWF) and resolve payroll discrepancies.
* HRMS \& Data Management
* Strong hands\-on experience with PeopleStrong HRMS (Must have).
* Maintain employee master data, dashboards, and MIS reports.
* Ensure accuracy of HR analytics, attendance, and leave records.
* Leverage HRMS and other tools to streamline processes and improve data accuracy.
* Hands\-on experience in HR data analytics to generate insights and reports on cost, attrition, absenteeism, and other key HR metrics to support strategic decision\-making and improvements.
* Compliance, Audit \& Statutory Management
* Ensure adherence to all statutory \& labour law requirements (PF, ESIC, PT, Shops \& Establishment, Gratuity, etc.).
* Support internal and external audits by preparing data, resolving audit queries, and ensuring compliance readiness.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders for timely filings and audit closures.
* Employee Grievance Handling \& Engagement
* Act as a point of contact for employee queries on HR policies, payroll, and benefits.
* Address grievances with sensitivity and ensure timely resolution.
* Support engagement activities and culture\-building initiatives.
* Policy \& Process Development
* Contribute to formulation and updation of HR policies and SOPs.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Drive process standardization and automation initiatives wherever possible.


**Skills \& Competencies Required**
* Mandatory: Hands\-on experience with PeopleStrong HRMS.
* Strong knowledge of payroll operations, reconciliations, and statutory compliances.
* Experience in handling audits and payroll reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with hands\-on experience in HR data analytics, reporting, and interpretation of key metrics (cost, attrition, absenteeism, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality, and ownership.


 Desired Candidate Profile
   

  

* 4–8 years of experience in HR/People Operations.
* MBA in Human Resources from a recognized institution.
* Immediate joiners are highly preferred.c

title: Sr Validation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Renesas Electronics is a dynamic, multicultural tech company where employees can learn, mentor, and thrive. Renesas brings together the strong financial foundation of a multi\-billion\-dollar global operation and the flexibility and velocity of a smaller organization. We are developing technologies for the latest advances in mobile computing, secured connected devices, autonomous driving, smart homes and factories, and more. Our solutions are at the heart of products developed by major innovators around the world. Join us and be part of what’s next in electronics. This is an opportunity to join a top\-notch BMS Team with Renesas’s leading Power Business Group. You will be part of a very skilled group of engineers who are helping build world class automotive and consumer BMS products. Your main responsibility will be to design, develop \& maintain Desktop \& Web Applications for Battery Management Systems, Automotives, Power tools, Power Charging Products and Solutions. As a key member of the team, you will play a crucial role in unifying customer experience to evaluate various BMS solutions by developing modern, state\-of\-the\-art applications. You will be a key driver in defining and architecting next\-generation Software for customers, application engineers, test engineers and developers to interact with our consumer, Industrial, Automotive power solutions.

 **Job Description**  

Senior Engineer Validation position is an IC role which requires 7\+ years of experience of Bench Validation and Debug of Power Management ICs as part of 2\.6B$ Power Business Unit at Renesas. Primary responsibilities include fully own Bench Validation, Silicon Debugs, Automation of Equipment and Tests of PMICs. Will also be responsible for analysing the data, documenting and reporting findings to the Systems team and work closely with Design \& Systems experts to ensure quality ICs. The role also involves opportunity to technically lead a small team with ownership of doing end to end IC validation.


The candidate should be able to develop and automate industry standard tests which are done for switching converters. In addition, the candidate should be able to define the equipment requirements for testing Power Management ICs and help setup lab from scratch. Ability to debug setups, equipment related issues and identify solutions is a must. The candidate needs to minimize Bench Testing cost while ensuring high quality in testing by employing standardization, reuse and automation.

 **Responsibilities**

* Maximise utilisation of Benches, equipment and resources through automation and industry best practices.
* Write bench test programs in Python, C, Labview and be able to debug ATE programs. Work with a mindset of smart work, collaboration with rest of the team
* In this technical role, candidate must be very strong hands on and should also be able to technically coach/mentor/ramp up new college graduates and freshers.
* Project the schedule for bench test program development, testing and debug based on the infrastructure and resource availability and identify gaps/risks for execution.
* Ownership and Accountability for accuracy, quality and presentation of all deliverables (waveforms, reports, documentation, results etc).
* Technically lead bench validation and debug of multiple PMICs out of Bengaluru, while working with design/systems teams which located at different geographies and in different time zones.
* Expertise of using Validation related equipment including various types of Power Supplies, Load Slammer, Scopes and probes, Multi\-meters, Analog switches, Relays, Computer to IC board communications etc.
* Must have experience of defining and driving Bench Validation plan for Power Management ICs and Evaluation Boards.
* Must be fluent with using FPGAs for testing Digital and emulating system behaviour.
* Must have experience with ATE\-Bench correlation and should be able to drive that independently.
* Should be well versed with one or more Power Chip Communication protocols e.g. SPMI, PMBUS, SVI3, SVID etc. Should be comfortable with I2C.
* Should be able to create basic circuits on bread board for experimentation and design PCBs.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Bench Validation of Mixed Signal ICs, especially PMICs .
* Ability to work with clarity and predictable timelines to ensure deliverables with high quality.
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity.
* Results\-oriented and able to deliver on\-time under tight schedule pressure.

  

**Additional Information**  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.  

  

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  

  

At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.


Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?


Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.

### **Job Description**


The Associate \- Growth (GRW) and Customer Success (CS) is a dual\-function, client\-facing role that sits at the intersection of two equally important commercial responsibilities – generating new business \& revenue and retaining existing clients. On the Growth side, you will identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities – owning the full sales cycle from first contact to signed agreement. On the Customer Success side, you will manage existing client relationships – ensuring renewals are completed on time, clients are trained and engaged, escalations are resolved, and the company's recurring revenue is protected and grown.

  

This role is applicable across the company – with the specific product set, target client segment, and geographic territory defined by the Reporting Head at the time of joining.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. New Business Development \& Lead Generation**

* Follow up on assigned leads and arrange meetings with prospective B2B clients across the assigned territory / zone in a timely and structured manner.
* Generate leads independently through field experience, market research, referrals, networking, and observation of industry events and regulatory developments.
* Research prospective client institutions – their business profile, organizational structure, regulatory context, and technology maturity – to build relevant engagement and project strategies.
* Attend industry events, conferences, and seminars to identify new prospects and build APT's presence and credibility in target markets.
* Maintain an organized, current pipeline of all prospects in the CRM system at all times.

 **2\. Product Demonstrations \& Pre\-Sales Engagement**

* Develop thorough, in\-depth functional knowledge of all assigned APT products – for both sales conversations and post\-sale client advisory.
* Conduct structured, confident product demonstrations and presentations for prospective clients – positioning APT's solutions as the most relevant fit for the client's specific needs.
* Prepare supporting documentation – quotations, product notes, and proposal decks – to move deals forward efficiently and professionally.
* Handle commercial negotiations within approved parameters and close business deals – ensuring full documentation is handed over accurately to the CS and Billing teams.
* Consistently work towards and surpass assigned quarterly and annual new business targets.

 **3\. Client Relationship Management \& Account Retention**

* Develop long\-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across assigned existing client accounts – positioning yourself as a reliable, knowledgeable, and responsive point of contact.
* Schedule and conduct regular client meetings and structured check\-ins – monitoring satisfaction levels, addressing concerns proactively, and reinforcing the value of APT's products and services.
* Create and execute quarterly client engagement plans – structured around key accounts, upcoming renewals, and product awareness or training needs.
* Act as the first point of contact for client complaints and escalations – owning the resolution process and coordinating internally to ensure prompt, professional closure.
* Proactively seek and document client feedback and share structured insights with the concerned teams.

 **4\. AMC \& Subscription Renewal Management**

* Take full ownership of AMC and subscription renewals for all assigned client accounts – tracking renewal timelines, initiating engagement well in advance, and ensuring zero unplanned churn.
* Prepare, present, and negotiate renewal proposals and commercial quotes with clients – handling negotiations confidently and finalizing agreements.
* Identify and actively pursue **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities** within the existing client base – introducing clients to additional APT products or service tiers that genuinely address their evolving needs.
* Maintain accurate, current records of all renewals, client interactions, and commercial discussions in the CRM system.

 **5\. Client Training \& Product Awareness**

* Conduct product training sessions and awareness programs for assigned clients – helping them maximize adoption, utilization, and value from APT's products and services.
* Proactively advise clients on product updates, new features, and best practices that could benefit their organization.
* Prepare client\-facing training documentation, user guides, and awareness materials where required.

 **6\. Market Intelligence \& Internal Collaboration**

* Track competitor activity, market trends, and regulatory developments – and share structured insights with the teams at defined intervals.
* Provide field intelligence to the concerned team(s) to support product positioning, campaigns, and collateral development.
* Collaborate proactively with the Product Delivery, Product Development, and Marketing teams to address client needs and ensure a seamless client experience across the entire lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, deal stages, renewal timelines, and pipeline activity in the CRM system.
* Provide regular, structured updates to the Reporting Head on new business pipeline, renewal status, client health, and market observations.

 **Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* Graduates / Professional Degree\-holders / Post\-Graduates desirous of a career spanning both Business Development / Sales and Client Relationship Management in the IT Software Solutions / Services space.
* 2\-3 years of overall experience. Freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and client orientation are actively encouraged to apply.
* Pleasing personality with excellent oral and written communication skills – a non\-negotiable prerequisite for this client\-facing role.
* Sound presentation creation and delivery skills – including the ability to engage confidently with senior institutional stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving aptitude – with the clarity and composure to understand client issues and find structured, practical resolutions.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities – new business conversations, active renewals, client relationships, and internal coordination – without losing detail or urgency.
* Character traits of patience, resilience, and adaptability – essential for navigating long sales cycles while simultaneously sustaining trusted client relationships.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to extensively travel across assigned territory *(within the city and PAN India, by any means of transport)* – and a genuine passion for daily client interaction.
* Proficiency in MS Office – particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
* Keen desire for collaboration and interaction with internal cross\-functional teams.

 **Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* Prior experience of 2 years in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Client Relationship Management – ideally in IT Software Solutions / Services, with a demonstrable track record.
* Prior exposure to the BFSI sector – including banks, NBFCs, cooperative institutions, mutual fund houses, insurance companies, or financial training institutions – in a sales or relationship management capacity.
* Basic understanding of Banking / Financial Services – including regulatory frameworks, compliance dynamics, AMC / subscription commercial models, or technology adoption trends.
* Experience of engaging with mid\-profile or senior institutional clients and stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization.
* Working knowledge of CRM software for pipeline management, renewal tracking, and client interaction records and exposure to AMC, subscription\-based, or SaaS commercial models and the associated renewal and upsell processes.

description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.
**Shell in India**

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R\&D, digitalisation , and business operations.  



Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net\-zero emissions energy business by 2050\. As India moves towards its target of net\-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.  



Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end\-to\-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world\-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350\-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.  



Shell owns and operates a LNG re\-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck\-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1\.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.  



Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting\-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.  



We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco\-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light , Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.


* \-

Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
**About the Role :**

description:
Job Description (JD)Data Entry Operator (DEO) – PM\-JAYDepartment

PM\-JAY / Medical Records / Billing

Reports To

PM\-JAY Coordinator / TPA Executive / Hospital Administrator

Job Purpose

To ensure accurate registration, verification, documentation, claim processing, and data management of PM\-JAY beneficiaries in accordance with National Health Authority (NHA) guidelines and hospital policies.

Key ResponsibilitiesPatient Registration

* Verify beneficiary eligibility through the PM\-JAY portal.
* Register eligible patients accurately on the PM\-JAY system.
* Generate Transaction Management System (TMS) IDs and maintain beneficiary records.
* Collect and verify Aadhaar, ABHA, ration card, and other required documents.

Data Entry \& Documentation

* Enter patient demographic, clinical, diagnostic, and treatment details accurately.
* Upload all mandatory documents on the PM\-JAY portal.
* Maintain complete digital and physical records of all PM\-JAY cases.
* Ensure confidentiality and security of patient information.

Pre\-Authorization \& Claims

* Prepare and upload pre\-authorization requests.
* Coordinate with treating consultants for required clinical documents.
* Submit claims within prescribed timelines.
* Track claim status and respond to insurer/authority queries promptly.
* Assist in claim resubmission and deficiency compliance.

Coordination

* Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, billing department, MRD, and insurance coordinators.
* Liaise with PM\-JAY district/state authorities whenever required.
* Assist beneficiaries regarding scheme benefits and documentation requirements.

Record Management

* Maintain daily admission and discharge records.
* Update PM\-JAY dashboards and MIS reports.
* Preserve all documents for audit purposes.
* Ensure proper filing of approvals, discharge summaries, investigation reports, consent forms, and claim documents.

Compliance

* Follow PM\-JAY operational guidelines and NHA protocols.
* Ensure zero fraudulent or duplicate entries.
* Support internal, external, and government audits.
* Maintain compliance with NABH and hospital quality standards.

Daily Reporting

* Daily beneficiary registration report.
* Pre\-authorization pending report.
* Claim submission report.
* Claim deficiency report.
* Rejected claim tracker.
* Pending document tracker.
* Monthly MIS submission.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline (preferred).
* Diploma/Certificate in Computer Applications.
* Experience in PM\-JAY, TPA, Medical Billing, or Hospital Administration preferred.

Experience

* 1–3 years in hospital data entry, PM\-JAY, insurance, or medical records.
* Freshers with relevant computer skills may also be considered.

Technical Skills

* PM\-JAY BIS and TMS Portal
* MS Excel, Word, Outlook
* Hospital Information Management System (HIMS/HMIS)
* Medical documentation
* Typing speed of at least 35 WPM (English) and proficiency in local language typing is desirable.

Key Competencies

* High accuracy in data entry
* Attention to detail
* Good communication skills
* Time management
* Documentation skills
* Teamwork
* Problem\-solving ability
* Confidentiality and ethical conduct

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* ≥98% data entry accuracy.
* 100% claim submission within prescribed timelines.
* Minimal claim rejections due to documentation errors.
* Timely response to claim deficiencies.
* Complete and audit\-ready documentation.
* Compliance with PM\-JAY and hospital SOPs.
* Daily MIS submission without delay.

Working Conditions

* 8–9 hour duty with rotational shifts as per hospital requirements.
* Availability during audits, inspections, and high patient load periods.
* Computer\-based work requiring continuous coordination with clinical and administrative departments.

title: Hospital Finanace & Billing Executive
description:
**NEWGEN MULTI\-SPECIALITY HOSPITAL**

*Perumbakkam, Chennai \| Beyond Cure*

**JOB DESCRIPTION – FINANCE \& BILLING EXECUTIVE**

**Job Title**

Finance \& Billing Executive

**Department**

Finance \& Billing

**Reporting To**

Finance Manager / Hospital Administrator

**Location**

Newgen Multi\-Speciality Hospital, Perumbakkam, Chennai

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time

**Work Schedule**

6 days a week; rotational shifts as per hospital requirements

**Job Purpose**

The Finance \& Billing Executive is responsible for accurate and timely billing of all inpatient (IP) and outpatient (OP) services, cash and collections management, insurance/TPA coordination, and day\-to\-day finance and accounts support. The role ensures transparent billing for patients, minimal revenue leakage, and compliance with hospital policies and statutory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Billing Operations**

* Prepare and process OP and IP bills accurately, covering consultations, procedures, lab, pharmacy, room charges, and other services as per the approved tariff.
* Generate interim and final bills for inpatients; explain bill details clearly to patients and attenders at admission, during stay, and at discharge.
* Coordinate with wards, OT, lab, pharmacy, and front office to ensure all services rendered are captured and billed without omission.
* Process discharge billing promptly to minimise patient waiting time; obtain necessary approvals for discounts or concessions as per policy.

**Cash, Collections \& Reconciliation**

* Handle cash, card, UPI, and online payment collections; issue receipts and maintain accurate daily collection records.
* Perform daily cash closing, shift handover reconciliation, and deposit of collections as per hospital procedure.
* Track advances, refunds, and outstanding dues; follow up on pending payments and credit bills.

**Insurance \& TPA Coordination**

* Verify insurance eligibility, obtain pre\-authorisations, and coordinate with TPAs/insurers for cashless approvals and enhancements.
* Prepare and submit claim documents; follow up on claim settlements, queries, and rejections until closure.
* Guide patients on insurance coverage, exclusions, and co\-payment amounts in a clear and courteous manner.

**Accounts \& Reporting**

* Maintain billing records, registers, and supporting documents for audit readiness.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly revenue and collection reports (department\-wise, doctor\-wise) for management review.
* Support the finance team with data entry, vendor invoice processing, petty cash tracking, and basic bookkeeping as required.
* Assist during internal and statutory audits by providing accurate records and clarifications.

**Compliance \& Patient Service**

* Ensure billing practices comply with hospital policies, tariff structures, and applicable statutory/GST requirements.
* Handle billing\-related patient queries and grievances politely; escalate unresolved issues to the reporting manager.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient and financial information at all times.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field (B.Com / BBA / M.Com preferred).
* 1–3 years of experience in hospital billing, healthcare finance, or accounts; freshers with strong accounting knowledge may be considered.
* Working knowledge of hospital information systems (HIS) / billing software and MS Excel.
* Familiarity with insurance/TPA processes and basic GST concepts is an added advantage.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills in Tamil and English; ability to explain bills patiently to patients and families.
* Integrity and accountability in handling cash and financial data.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage discharge\-time rush, and multitask across counters.
* Team player with a service\-oriented, patient\-first attitude.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Billing accuracy rate (errors per bills processed).
* Average discharge billing turnaround time.
* Daily cash reconciliation accuracy (zero unexplained variance).
* TPA claim submission timeliness and settlement rate.
* Reduction in revenue leakage and pending outstanding dues.

*This job description outlines the primary duties of the role and is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may be revised based on organisational requirements.*

title: Network Engineer
description:
We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.
 



 Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.
 



 As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities.
 



**Why you will love this opportunity as Network Engineer at Civica** 




 We are looking for a skilled Network Engineer to become part of our Civica Team. This position demands a solid background in Infrastructure Engineering along with extensive experience in wide\-area networking technologies and enterprise environments.
 



 As a Network Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting, maintaining, monitoring, and enhancing our global network infrastructure. Your efforts will ensure that our network services are consistently stable, secure, and fully operational across office locations, cloud platforms, data centers, and enterprise connectivity services worldwide.
 



 As a key member of the Level 2 team, you will take the lead in delivering independent support, troubleshooting challenges, and driving impactful changes across our global network environment—empowering both daily operations and groundbreaking infrastructure transformation projects.
 



 You will work closely with platform engineers, hardware engineers, and other network engineers, serving as an escalation point for tactical network issues raised by Support and Operations teams.
 



 At Civica, we excel in a fast\-paced global setting, which may sometimes offer you the exciting chance to work beyond standard business hours.
 



**What you'll be doing:** 



* Provide operational assistance for global office and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, performance and availability to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Independently troubleshoot switching, routing, firewall, wireless and connectivity services, using monitoring and diagnostic data.
* Execute operational changes within approved standards, including patching, firmware upgrades and maintenance activities.
* Assist with infrastructure deployment, migration, and transformation initiatives.
* Work with colleagues, stakeholders and vendors to resolve issues and maintain service stability.
* Maintain technical documentation, standards and runbooks. ·
* Escalate complex or systemic issues where required.
* Support continual improvement initiatives focused on stability, standardisation and automation.


**Requirements**

**What you will bring:** 




**Mandatory Technical Competencies** 



* Experience in supporting enterprise environments utilizing Fortinet, Cisco, and Meraki technologies.
* Layer 2 switching technologies and the design/troubleshooting of VLANs.
* Firewall operations, Layer 3 routing technologies, and policy management, along with Azure network connectivity (VPN) expertise.

\* Basic knowledge of food and beverage service.

\* Familiarity with POS systems is an added advantage.

Working Conditions

\* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

\* Standing and walking for extended periods.

\* Ability to carry trays, plates, and service equipment safely.

Performance Standards

\* Deliver exceptional guest service that exceeds customer expectations.

\* Maintain Olegio’s standards of cleanliness, professionalism, and hospitality.

\* Ensure prompt, courteous, and efficient service at all times.

\* Comply with all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), food safety regulations, and workplace safety guidelines.

Olegio Gastronomy Pvt. Ltd. is committed to delivering authentic European hospitality through exceptional food, outstanding service, and memorable guest experiences. title: SCRUM MASTER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 As a trained Scrum Master, you are responsible for facilitating a Scrum team and are accountable for removing impediments of the team to achieve the sprint goals/deliverables. You are responsible to ensure that the Scrum process is used as intended. A key part of your role is to protect the development team, allow the teams  to be self managed, foster collaboration across teams and keep them focused on the tasks at hand.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* Is accountable for meeting Sprint objectives along with scrum team
* Ensure meeting of sprint commitment
* Own and help resolve impediments of the team
* Help PO adopt Scrum Process properly and ensure PO availability
* Support the PO in maintaining the Product Backlog, defining User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate estimation, backlog refinement and all planning ceremonies
* Ensure that DOR, DOD, Acceptance criteria is available and adhered to
* Ensure MoSCoW adherence of Sprint Backlog at the Sprint level
* Accountable for the correct implementation of the Agile Process
* Protect the team from external interference.
* Facilitate technical assistance to the team and enables clear communication amongst the team members
* Participate in Scrum of Scrum across teams and highlights impediments
* Provide feedback on the team members performance to the Agile Line manager and Agile Program Leader
* Facilitate all the Scrum Ceremonies (Planning, Daily Standup, Grooming, Demo, restrospection) and ensure correct adoption


 ͏
 * Ensure updating of all Scrum artifacts
* Ensure ALM tool (either client or Wipro) is updated on a daily basis
* Update key Scrum metrics into Wipro internal tool on a Sprint\-by\-Sprint basis
* Analyse key Scrum metrics and take corrective actions
* Create competency improvement and cross\-skilling plan for the team (by the start of the project). Review monthly and ensure improvement in competency score. Ensure multiskilling for at least 50% of the team.
* Help team attain stable velocity within 6\-8 sprints (allowing for 10% variation either way)
* Train team on the proper adoption of Agile processes  (Scrum / XP / Kanban)
* Help in adoption of engineering practices like ATDD, TDD, CI, CD, Refactoring
* Record and own the restrospection actions
* Participate in community of practice initiatives
* Provide inputs to the Line manager for internal quality forums (QIC  / APR / QBR / MBR etc.)


 ͏ ͏
 
 Mandatory Skills: Agile Scrum Methodology .
 



  
 



 Experience: 5\-8 Years
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Scrum Master(Agile Methodology, Client Handling, Reporting)
   

  

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure consistent Agile execution.
* Coach team members on Scrum principles, Agile mindset, and continuous improvement practices to enhance delivery predictability and quality.
* Identify, track, and proactively remove impediments; escalate risks and dependencies appropriately to protect sprint goals.
* Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to support backlog readiness, prioritization discussions, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Drive client handling activities: manage expectations, communicate progress, and facilitate alignment on scope, timelines, and delivery outcomes.
* Maintain delivery transparency using Agile metrics and reporting (e.g., sprint progress, velocity trends, burn\-down/burn\-up, risks/issues).
* Support multi\-team coordination where applicable, ensuring dependency management and consistent ways of working across squads.
* Promote a healthy team culture by encouraging collaboration, accountability, and constructive conflict resolution.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years of overall experience with strong hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master in Agile delivery environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in Agile methodology and Scrum practices, including facilitation and coaching of teams.
* Proven experience in client handling, stakeholder communication, and managing delivery expectations.
* Experience creating and maintaining clear delivery reports and status updates for internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience supporting multiple teams or complex programs with cross\-team dependencies and shared milestones.
* Strong reporting and storytelling skills—able to translate metrics into insights, actions, and clear executive\-ready updates.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives using retrospective outcomes and measurable team health indicators.
* Strong facilitation skills for client workshops, requirement clarification sessions, and alignment meetings.
* Exposure to Agile scaling practices and working with distributed teams across time zones.
